title: Validate end-to-end science factory on city block chassis
description: Wire Level 1 macro floorplanner, Level 2 block PnR, and channel router. Synthesize science factory target on city block chassis and verify headless simulation and zero DRC.

title: Implement Level 1 macro floorplanner for recipe clustering
description: Implement Level 1 macro floorplanner to cluster netlist instances into discrete blocks, handle multi-block allocation for large stages, and assign inter-block nets to channel lanes.

title: Implement OpenROAD floorplanning and placement blockages for chassis
description: Update OpenROAD floorplanning to emit DEF DIEAREA as NxM grid with PLACEMENT BLOCKAGE on street channels. Verify standard cells place strictly within 94x94 core areas.

title: Implement router intersection and channel routing primitives
description: Design 4-way router intersection module using vanilla underground belts and splitters. Define channel lane allocation for 6-tile streets. Add tests in test/channel_router_test.py.

title: Implement chassis abstraction and Type 1 city block template
description: Define ChassisTemplate ABC in foundry/chassis.py and implement CityBlockChassis with base blueprint generation for pavement, poles, and radars. Add unit tests in test/chassis_test.py.

title: Implement chassis-based factory layout architecture
description: Implement hierarchical chassis-based physical design flow using Type 1 square city blocks as defined in docs/chassis_layout_architecture.md.

title: Synthesize and verify utility science pack flow
description: Add flow targets, netlist recipes, and test harness assertions for utility-science-pack (yellow science)
notes: Utility science factory remains disabled pending resolution of DRC-08 surface crossings.

title: Synthesize and verify production science pack flow
description: Add flow targets, netlist recipes, and test harness assertions for production-science-pack (purple science)

title: Fix fluid connection ports for machines and recipes to light up all machines
Resolve belt routing DRC-05 and DRC-08 in chemical science factory
description: Chemical science factory blueprint has remaining belt routing conflicts (DRC-08 unresolved surface crossings) and unreachable input inserters (DRC-05). Resolve belt jumpers, trunk routes, and inserter approach routing to achieve zero DRC errors and enable strict_drc.

title: Optimize jumper resolution algorithm in def2bp
description: Jumper resolution in foundry/jumper.py scales quadratically over large layouts. The resolver scans all conflicts and builds candidate option sets repeatedly per conflict, causing high CPU and memory usage. Optimize candidate evaluation, conflict indexing, and batch jumper resolution.

title: Fix pipe routing and fluid connectivity for chemical science factories
description: Chemical science pack factories do not produce functional piping. Chemical plants and fluid networks fail to route and connect pipes correctly during factory synthesis and layout generation. Investigate fluid routing, pipe rasterization, and underground jumper resolution to restore functional fluid piping.
close_reason: Fixed pipe-to-ground underground directions, implemented physical DRC checks for fluid mixing (DRC-13), pipe pairing (DRC-14), and span collisions (DRC-15). Enhanced def_untangle with M1/M2 overlapping track and adjacent fluid route separation. Verified chemical science blueprint builds with zero fluid mixing and zero pipe pairing errors.

title: Prune hardcoded FLUID_MATERIALS and derive from active game config
Refactor def_untangle.py into modular package with spatial indexing
Lint and eliminate hardcoded routing coordinates in def_untangle
Support dynamic chunk generation and placement bounds in bp2save for large factories
Support multi-domain PDN and power-gated factory controllers
Support off-chip power generation for factory floorplans
description: Only place electric poles in standard cells and core routing. Remove electricity generators from individual cell macros. Synthesize a single external generator outside the floorplan boundary and connect it to the Power Distribution Network (PDN).

title: Synthesize dedicated power plants for factory designs
description: Calculate required factory electrical wattage from machine demands. Synthesize dedicated power plant sub-layouts (such as steam boilers, solar fields, or nuclear power plants) and connect them to the factory Power Distribution Network (PDN).
